<!-- A gomock expectation that is not met, the usual "red" example on a slide. Line numbers in gomock's message are mapped onto the visible code like compiler errors; `controller.go` is gomock's own file. Needs network the first time (go.uber.org/mock). -->

```{.go .run .test .output .expect-failure .go-generate module="example.com/rocket" filename="rocket_test.go" go-get="-tool go.uber.org/mock/mockgen@v0.6.0"}
package rocket

import (
	"testing"

	"go.uber.org/mock/gomock"
)

// <noshow>
type Radio interface{ Send(msg string) error }

// </noshow>
func Countdown(r Radio) error { return r.Send("T-1") }

//go:generate go tool mockgen -source=rocket_test.go -destination=mock_test.go -package=rocket

func TestCountdown(t *testing.T) {
	radio := NewMockRadio(gomock.NewController(t))
	radio.EXPECT().Send("T-0").Return(nil)
	Countdown(radio)
}
```
